title: What operating conditions does a supplier need to know for corrosion protection in a bogie-hearth furnace?
summary: Corrosion protection cannot be assessed from the equipment name alone. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s bogie-hearth furnace proposal dated 25 February 2024 specifies different materials for heating elements, the inner exhaust pipe and outer duct, using a double-wall duct for exhaust, make-up air and furnace-pressure control. First identify substances carried in by workpieces, emissions during heating and the medium contacting each component, then confirm materials, ventilation and downstream treatment. One material grade cannot establish corrosion resistance of the whole furnace.
